experiments.emptyDescription: This app has no Product Page Optimization experiment. Apple needs the app to be live on the App Store, and a test takes up to three treatments. Create one in App Store Connect, then sync again.
experiments.heading: Product Page Optimization experiments
experiments.neverDescription: Sync to read the experiments of this app from App Store Connect. Nothing is changed in the store.
google.body: The Google Play developer API has no store listing experiments and no custom store listings, so Kiln cannot read or change them. Manage them in the Play Console and keep your own record below.
google.limitExperiments: One default graphics experiment, or up to five localized experiments, can run at the same time. An experiment stops by itself after 6 months.
google.limitListings: An app can have up to 50 custom store listings, each reached by its own address.
google.title: Experiments and custom listings live in the Play Console
noteDialog.description: Kiln keeps this note for you. Nothing is sent to a store.
noteDialog.listingHint: The value after listing= in the address of the custom store listing. Lowercase letters, digits and . - _ ~
noteDialog.name: Name
noteDialog.namePlaceholder: For example: Icon test, spring campaign
noteDialog.noteHint: What you tested and what you learned. Up to 2,000 characters.
noteDialog.saveFailed: The note could not be saved. Try again.
noteDialog.urlHint: Optional: the address of the page or the console view.
notes.deleteFailed: The note could not be deleted. Try again.
notes.emptyDescriptionApple: Write down what you plan to test or what you learned. Kiln does not read this from the App Store.
notes.emptyDescriptionGoogle: Google Play has no API for experiments or custom listings, so this list is the record Kiln can keep: what you test, when, and what you learned.
notes.heading: Manual tracker
notes.leadApple: Your own notes about tests and pages, kept in Kiln. They are not read from or sent to the store.
notes.leadGoogle: Kiln cannot read Google Play experiments or custom listings. Keep your own record here and open the Play Console to run them.
notes.openListing: Open the listing on Google Play
pages.emptyDescription: This app has no custom product page. An app can have up to 70, each with its own screenshots, previews and promotional text. Create them in App Store Connect, then sync again.
pages.heading: Custom product pages
pages.iosOnly: Custom product pages are for iPhone and iPad apps: read them on the iOS record of this app.
pages.neverDescription: Sync to read the custom product pages of this app from App Store Connect.
pages.neverTitle: Custom product pages not read yet
results.body: Apple's API does not give the results of a test (impressions, conversion, confidence) or the numbers of a custom product page. They are in App Store Connect, under App Analytics.
results.title: Results are in App Store Connect
sync.failedKept: The last sync failed. Showing what was read {{ago}}. {{error}}
sync.never: Not read yet. Sync to read the experiments and custom product pages.
sync.partial: Read {{ago}}. The lists were cut at their limit: the store may have more.
tab.aboutApple: Apple's Product Page Optimization tests up to three treatments of your product page against the original, and custom product pages give a campaign its own page. Kiln reads them from App Store Connect.
tab.aboutGoogle: Google Play calls them store listing experiments and custom store listings. They are managed in the Play Console only.
tab.aboutReadOnly: Kiln reads and shows them. It cannot create, start, stop or change an experiment or a page: do that in the store's console.
tab.headlineCount: Experiments and custom product pages, as of the last sync
tab.headlineGoogle: Experiments on Google Play are managed in the Play Console
tab.headlineNone: No experiments or custom product pages read
tab.leadHintApple: As of the last sync. Read only.
tab.leadHintGoogle: Google Play has no API for these: use the Play Console and the tracker below.
tab.partsTitle: Some parts could not be read
tab.syncDone: Sync done. Experiments: {{experiments}}. Custom product pages: {{pages}}.
tab.syncFailedNetwork: The sync could not be completed. Try again.
